snippet.title: Warframe | SIRIUS: Jade Shadows: Constellations - Official Animated Short
snippet.description:
"The fiercest strike is the one unseen. I was not looking for an apprentice when I found the boy. It was a sign: to secure the future, one final death will pay for all." - RYOKU

Digital Extremes has once again partnered with legendary animation studio, @THELINEanimation,  to reveal Jade Shadows: Constellations, coming in June. Witness a spectacular clash between Sirius and Orion high above the Orb Vallis, set to “Crawl Backwards Out of Heaven” by world-renowned metal band, @ERRAband.

To learn more about Jade Shadows: Constellations, visit: https://warframe.com/news/jade-shadows-constellations

Visit The Line Studio at https://www.thelinestudio.com or on social media:

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/THELINEanimation
X: https://www.twitter.com/thelinestudio
Insta: https://www.instagram.com/thelineanimation/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@thelineanimation
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/thelineanimation

THE LINE ANIMATION STUDIO CREDITS:

Director: Louve Karnas
Producer: Macarena Gaset
Art Director: Justine Thibault
Production Manager: Denise Cirone
Animation Lead: Quentin Rigaux
Compositing Lead: Maxime Temple
CG Supervisor: Pete Addington
Cleanup Lead: Clara Schildhauer
Production Assistant: Bingqi Liu
Executive Creative Director: Tim McCourt
Executive Producer: Laura Breaden
Head of Production: Nick Miller
Head of Animation: Kwok Fung Lam
Head of Compositing: Freddie Lewis-Wall
Head of Art: Juancho Crespo
Talent & Scheduling Coordinator: Jesus Ovejero
Marketing Manager: Ella Johnston

MUSIC CREDITS:

Song Title: "Crawl Backwards Out of Heaven"
Artist: ERRA
Composition & Lyrics: Daniel Braunstein, Jesse Cash, and J.T. Cavey
Performers: Jesse Cash, J.T. Cavey, Alex Ballew, Conor Hesse, Clint Tustin
Copyright Owner: UNFD, a division of UNIFIED Recorded Music
